answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 7465 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Masah on cotton socks is permissible or not? if any person is doing imamat by doing wazu by masa on his cotton socks can we join his imamat or not? Question: Masah on cotton socks is permissible or not? if any person is doing imamat by doing wazu by masa on his cotton socks can we join his imamat or not? Answer ID: 7465 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 875/875=M/1429) The cotton socks do not have the conditions necessary for masah ; therefore masah shall not be valid on them. The imamah of a person who does masah on his cotton socks is not right; you should not pray salah behind him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
